dz: 圣剑之利沃尼亚兄弟会(Livonian Brothers of the Sword)是天主教军事秩序,作为利沃尼亚十字军的一部分占领了塔尔巴图(今塔尔图).
de: The Livonian Brothers of the Sword, a Catholic military order, occupy Tarbatu (today Tartu) as part of the Livonian Crusade.
